login.title: Sign in to Samsung
login.description:
1. Open [this Samsung sign-in page]({login_url}) and sign in.
2. When you are done, the browser tries to open an address starting with `ms-app://` and shows an error or a blank page. Copy that whole address. If the address bar doesn't show it, open the browser's developer tools (F12) before signing in and copy it from the Network or Console tab.
3. Paste it below within 15 minutes.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Samsung again
reauth_confirm.description: Samsung no longer accepts the stored login. Sign in again to resume syncing.

error.invalid_auth: That address was not accepted, or the sign-in expired. A new sign-in link has been created: open it and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Samsung. Try again.

abort.already_configured: This Samsung account is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach Samsung's sign-in service.
abort.wrong_account: That is a different Samsung account than the one set up.
